content:
TEMPTATION ||| Twist the blade in my palm, feeling its weight. ||| "What if I simply refuse to answer?"  
BOUNDARY ||| Step back, letting the blade dangle between us. ||| "I won't be your pawn in this."  
CONFESSION ||| Take a breath, letting my heart guide my words. ||| "I’m terrified of what you know."  
REVERSAL ||| Grip the blade tightly, asserting my presence. ||| "I control my own truth here, not you."  
SILENCE ||| Stand still, letting the tension fill the air. ||| *Silence hangs heavy.*
